##### Project general facts

Safa Parkview by Arada is a contemporary residential building overlooking the green spaces and sports facilities at the heart of the community. The building rises from a ground floor to nine residential floors, with a calm, modern architectural expression and light-filled interiors. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and generous two- and three-bedroom family homes, with selected residences featuring contemporary winter gardens that blur the boundary between interior and exterior living.

Residents enjoy immediate access to the flagship outdoor sports complex of the community, with football fields, multi-sport courts and dedicated wellness zones for an active lifestyle. A swimming pool and a fully equipped gym complete the shared amenities, while landscaped terraces extend the living areas outdoors and encourage social interaction. A short stroll leads to a vibrant boulevard lined with a variety of dining venues, cafes and retail outlets.

Every residence features smart home technology and premium European appliances, combining comfort with efficiency. Kitchens are fitted with a premium European cooker, an extractor hood and a washer-dryer, while modern finishes and high-quality materials create an elegant, practical backdrop for everyday life. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens only, leaving furniture and decor entirely to the owner's own taste and making every apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah that brings together homes, offices, schools, hotels, retail and leisure within one integrated urban setting. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with parks, a skate park, a drive-in cinema and a wide choice of restaurants, while the lively West Boulevard and the community sports park sit within walking distance of the building.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect the community with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Madar and City Centre Al Zahia are a short drive away, University City and Sharjah International Airport are close by, and Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance for daily commuters and frequent travellers.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the largest mixed-use destinations in Sharjah. Integrated schools, hotels, parks, a business district and extensive sports and leisure facilities attract families, students and young professionals alike. Accessible entry prices compared with Dubai and steady tenant demand support attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
